title: Part
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. On the first face, draw the first loop as a circle centered at coordinates [0.0225, 0.0225] with a radius of 0.0225 units. For the second loop, draw another circle with the same center but a smaller radius of 0.015 units. Scale the entire 2D sketch by a factor of 0.045. Transform this scaled sketch into a 3D space by rotating it with Euler angles set to zero and translating it with a vector also set to zero. Extrude the transformed sketch along its normal direction by 0.75 units to create a solid cylindrical body. Ensure that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction. The final dimensions of the cylindrical body should be 0.045 units in length, 0.045 units in width, and 0.75 units in height. This cylindrical object has a pointed tip at the bottom and a flat top, resembling a pen.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the center and radius of the circles
center = (0.0225, 0.0225)
radius_outer = 0.0225
radius_inner = 0.015

# Create the outer circle
r = r.center(center[0], center[1]).circle(radius_outer)

# Create the inner circle
r = r.circle(radius_inner)

# Extrude the sketch to create the pen body
r = r.extrude(0.75)

# The final model is represented as 'r'

lanes.label: Cadabra 4B (ours) · 1 sample
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0225, 0.0225)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.0225)  # Draw the outer circle
    .circle(0.015)  # Draw the inner circle
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Tube with outer diameter 0.0450 and inner diameter 0.0280, height 0.7500
outer_radius = 0.0450 / 2
inner_radius = 0.0280 / 2
height = 0.7500

# Create the outer cylinder
outer_cylinder = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(outer_radius).extrude(height)

# Create the inner cylinder (hole)
inner_cylinder = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(inner_radius).extrude(height)

# Cut the inner cylinder from the outer cylinder to make the tube
r = outer_cylinder.cut(inner_cylinder)
